title: Secure email change
summary: Local public accounts can change their email securely: confirm the new address with a signed link before it switches, notify both the old and new addresses, and cancel any outstanding request from the profile. Directory and Cloudron emails stay directory-sourced.
changes: Replace the read-only profile email panel with a local-only secure email change flow gated by password confirmation.
Store a single pending email change, send a signed confirmation link to the new address, and update email plus verified status only after confirmation.
Notify the current address when a change starts and notify old and new addresses when it completes; allow cancelling a pending change.
Reject expired or invalid confirmation links and refuse email changes for directory-owned accounts.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: secure email change after username and verification hardening (0.39.3).
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: TOTP and passkeys remain later Account security waves; this release does not add multifactor enrolment.
Directory and Cloudron OIDC staff emails remain directory-owned and cannot be changed in MyAPES Account.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Pending email-change rows become unused after rollback; no irreversible data migration beyond optional pending rows that can be dropped.
